description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Digital Force Technologies develops full-stack mission systems for national security applications. The SeraphimOS UI/UX engineer designs and implements operator interfaces that present sensor data and autonomous system behavior clearly, supporting critical decisions under pressure.
UI/UX Software Engineer building situational-awareness interfaces, geospatial visualizations, and reusable front-end components for sensor control

Responsibilities:
• Design and implement responsive interfaces for situational awareness, sensor & effector control, alerts, and operator workflows
• Turn dense geospatial and track data into clear visualizations with strong information hierarchy
• Partner with operators and product teams to validate interaction patterns and reduce cognitive burden
• Build reusable front-end components that remain effective during degraded connectivity and high event rates

Requirements:
• Hands-on C# and Unity experience on a production codebase, including runtime UI and editor tooling
• Experience with GIS or 3D mapping SDKs, ideally the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unity, and with geospatial data such as positions, tracks, and map layers
• Experience maintaining a multi-variant build and release pipeline (CI such as Jenkins or GitLab CI, and Windows installers)
• Experience connecting a desktop client to a message-bus backend (AMQP/RabbitMQ or similar)
• A relevant technical degree or equivalent demonstrated ability through work, research, internships, open-source contributions, or independent projects
• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Preferred:
• Mapping and geospatial libraries, WebGL, real-time streaming UIs, or desktop applications
• Experience with command-and-control, robotics, industrial control, or other high-consequence interfaces
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity, while maintaining strong technical judgment, code quality, and ownership
